fusions.name: Clamber and Stamp
fusions.desc: Clambers up the target and drives both heels down for 14 damage, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Summit Drop
fusions.desc: Drops from above onto an enemy up to 6 tiles away, dealing 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, up to 1.3 times that from full range.

fusions.name: Footing Found
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% and your dodge chance by 10% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Butting Back
fusions.desc: Each time something other than fire hurts you, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds. You also have 5% more dodge chance.
